skill.summary: Toggle features instantly without deploying code. A/B test variants, gradual rollouts from 1% to 100%, and emergency kill switches for AI agents.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Revamped documentation for easier onboarding, with a new Quick Start and updated use case sections.
- Clarified feature descriptions: instant toggling, granular percentage rollouts (1%–100%), A/B variant traffic splitting, and emergency kill switches.
- Improved explanation of commands with a new summary table for easier reference.
- Expanded list of trigger keywords and simplified audience-facing descriptions.
- Updated configuration and integration examples for better clarity and accuracy.
